carrier_payload.order: vocabulary.rows order; raw post-add/pre-scale values; scale taken from source CarrierWrite

head_capture_witness.analysis: post-execution stored-weight direction probes; no additional model traversal
head_capture_witness.parity: all prompt-position vocabulary logits bit-identical against fresh noop control
head_capture_witness.tap: canonical production softmax aggregation, before gate/W_O

head_payload.values: pre-W_O weighted V; actual source weights with window offset; f32 round-trip JSON

heads.method: Measured canonical per-head source weights and weighted V; derived raw direction attribution via stored W_O and selected unembedding rows. Signed score is not probability or a normalized logit change. No final norm, output multiplier or softcap; physical projection rounding may differ. Selected token directions only, not vocabulary top-k or additive normalized-logit attribution. Separate intrusive head capture, not Standard.

reconstruction.method: Sum stored-W_O per-head projections versus captured applied attention delta; f64 analysis vs production rounding

content.method: Stored W_O × captured head × residual scale; selected token directions, no final norm.

provider: observatory_record / prepared CPU output-head readout v1

readout_witness.criterion: last captured carrier readout equals canonical logits bit-for-bit at every prompt position

vocabulary.method: Recorded post-add carrier → recorded layer scale (when present) → prepared final norm → pinned output head, multiplier and softcap → full-vocabulary f64 softmax. Intermediate readouts are projections, not future predictions.

basis.construction: Gram-Schmidt of the first two ordered landmark directions; no fitting to the trajectory

token_map.graph_method: Union of each selected landmark’s 2 nearest neighbors by full-dimensional unit-row cosine; selected landmarks only; similarity, not executed or causal connectivity
token_map.method: Unit-normalized prepared final-norm carrier and unit-normalized stored output-head rows, projected into one fixed orthonormal plane. Geometry is directional; it is not probability or causal evidence.
